findings.title: The public findMany API was removed without replacing its query execution contract
findings.body: This change deletes `findMany(findManyArgs)`, which was the service's public method for applying authorization/filter conditions and executing a `BookingTimeStatusDenormalized` query. The new `getBaseConditions()` only returns a SQL fragment and requires every caller to reimplement query execution, selection, pagination, ordering, and composition of caller-provided `where` clauses. Existing TypeScript callers will fail to compile and JavaScript callers will fail at runtime; no caller migrations are included in this PR.

findings.title: Team and organization authorization SQL is never executed against the database
findings.body: The team and org tests only compare `Prisma.Sql` objects to other `Prisma.sql` objects. The sole `$queryRaw` test below exercises only the user-scope condition, so it does not validate the new `ANY(${array})` parameter binding or the team/org `isTeamBooking` branches on the actual database. A SQL serialization or PostgreSQL array-typing issue in the primary authorization scopes would therefore pass this suite despite returning no data or failing all team/org insights requests.
